coin.title: Official Restrike: Ducaton 2021 Gold 1 Ounce – Royal Delft Edition
coin.description: In 2021, the Royal Dutch Mint Ducaton is found in the familiar Royal Delft earthenware. The Delft Blue coin holder depicts classic Dutch scenery: a flat landscape with water, a windmill and beautiful flowers. We salute the Dutch landscape with this design. The artisanal coin holders by Royal Delft have become true collector’s items on their own. The Ducaton in Silver Proof comes with a uniquely numbered Certificate of Authenticity.
